# JD-LLM Development Framework

> A drop-in development framework for Claude Code with structured sprint workflows, TDD practices, quality gates, and backlog management.

## Project Entry Point
- CLAUDE.md: Project configuration, commands, conventions, skill quick-reference

## Key Documentation
- docs/reference/CODING_STANDARDS.md: Language-specific coding standards
- docs/reference/TESTING_STRATEGY.md: TDD workflow, test quality criteria, guard rails
- docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md: System architecture and module boundaries
- docs/reference/BACKLOG_INDEX.md: Epic and story status overview
- docs/progress.md: Sprint history and metrics

## Skills (invoked via /skill-name in Claude Code)
- .claude/skills/bootstrap/SKILL.md: First-run setup, auto-detect stack
- .claude/skills/sprint-start/SKILL.md: Pre-flight checks, branch creation
- .claude/skills/story-cycle/SKILL.md: Universal story delivery by type
- .claude/skills/sprint-end/SKILL.md: Quality gates, PR, merge
- .claude/skills/ideate/SKILL.md: Ideas → typed backlog stories
- .claude/skills/continue/SKILL.md: Smart session resumption
- .claude/skills/handoff/SKILL.md: Session end, handoff document
- .claude/skills/skill-create/SKILL.md: Generate technology-specific skills
- .claude/skills/parallel-work/SKILL.md: Git worktree management
- .claude/skills/architecture-check/SKILL.md: Architecture validation
- .claude/skills/SKILLS_INVENTORY.md: Full skill inventory

## Rules
- .claude/rules/testing.md: Test file protection rules
- .claude/rules/documentation.md: Documentation rules
- .claude/rules/security.md: Security-sensitive file rules
- .claude/rules/git.md: Git workflow rules
- .claude/rules/dependencies.md: Dependency management rules

## Prompt Snippets
- .claude/prompts/review-security.md: Security review of a specific file
- .claude/prompts/explain-pattern.md: Explain a code pattern in this codebase
- .claude/prompts/suggest-tests.md: Suggest test cases for a file

## Hooks
- .claude/hooks/post-edit-format.sh: Auto-format and auto-lint after edits
- .claude/hooks/pre-stop-quality.sh: Quality gate before completion
- .claude/hooks/pre-tool-safety.sh: Block dangerous operations (git, publishing, DB, process killing)

## Other
- CHANGELOG.md: Per-optimization changelog with test and revert instructions
